title: Welfare Facilities on Site
whatItIs: Every construction site needs toilets, washing facilities, drinking water and a place to rest and eat, plus changing rooms and lockers where needed. CDM 2015 Schedule 2 sets the minimum.

keyFacts.text: Suitable and sufficient toilets MUST be provided or made available at readily accessible places.
Washing facilities MUST be next to toilets, with hot and cold or warm water, soap and towels or other drying.
Rest areas MUST have tables, seats with backs, a way to boil water and to prepare and eat meals.
Welfare facilities MUST be available before any construction work starts.

keyFacts: A cold water tap and a chemical toilet on their own are not adequate facilities.

items.title: Toilets
items.text: Readily accessible, lit, ventilated and clean.

items.title: Washing
items.text: Next to toilets: hot and cold or warm water, soap, towels.

items.title: Drinking water
items.text: Wholesome, with cups unless it's an upward jet.

items.title: Changing and lockers
items.text: Where special clothing is worn: seating, lockers, a way to dry clothing.

items.title: Rest facilities
items.text: Tables, seats with backs, a way to boil water.

items.title: Heaters
items.text: Don't put clothing directly on heaters to dry it: there's a risk of fire.

a.label: Toilets
points: Men and women can share one in its own lockable room

b.label: Washbasins and showers
points: Basins for hands, face and forearms can be shared
Showers: shared only in a separate lockable room

onTheTest.question: Where must washing facilities be provided on a construction site?
options: Next to toilets and near changing rooms
onTheTest.why: CDM 2015, Schedule 2: washing facilities must be in the immediate vicinity of every toilet and near any changing rooms.

onTheTest.question: Bags of cement are being kept in the only rest area on site. Is this acceptable?
options: No: rest areas aren't for storing materials
Yes, if the bags are sealed
onTheTest.why: HSE CIS59: rest areas are not to be used to store plant, equipment or materials.

traps: Short jobs still need welfare. Mobile gangs can use facilities at a central place within reasonable reach.
Public toilets are acceptable only where it's impractical to provide other facilities.
Drinking water taps must be clearly marked if they could be confused with water that isn't fit to drink.
